# Third-party sources

- Speaker Badge by Hervé Studio, MIT, pinned at c9ed3efaf40a668fe0d3bec3d1aa91f52d58fab4: https://github.com/hervestudio/firmware-badge. License: SPEAKER-MIT.txt. `firmware/touch/speaker_motion.h` adapts `src/main.cpp`'s getIdle/pickNewLookTarget and `src/menu_ui.h`'s UiBubble/uiDrawHome. Changes: explicit instance ownership, injected time, C++ standard types, finite time guard, local non-security random source and display-scale-independent positions. `firmware/touch/avatar.cpp` adapts `src/anims_extra.h`'s irGenFrame sphere shading to Alook's face color and transparent RGB565 output. No original account, ESP-NOW, GPIO or reset logic is imported.
- Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C, Apache-2.0, pinned at b1f60c6fa708099bc3f1e9cb9e81d72b2e435c37: https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C. License: WAVESHARE-APACHE-2.0.txt. `firmware/touch/board.cpp` adapts Arduino 03_LVGL_AXP2101_ADC_Data and 05_LVGL_Widgets. Changes: one LVGL owner, bounded display buffer, polling without demo/reset behavior, actual button transitions and retained native power semantics. Vendor driver libraries retain their licenses in the pinned download.
- Noto Sans CJK SC Regular, SIL Open Font License 1.1, pinned at f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c/Sans. License: NOTO-OFL.txt. `tools/font.py` converts the selected Unicode ranges into an ignored LVGL font using lv_font_conv 1.5.3. The derivative font symbol is `alook_font_cjk`. Preview labels use the same font file.
- Lilita One by Juan Pablo del Peral, SIL Open Font License 1.1, pinned Google Fonts source at b9f4a43f3684f93a02b88133755deb51508c2fcf: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/b9f4a43f3684f93a02b88133755deb51508c2fcf/ofl/lilitaone. License: LILITA-ONE-OFL.txt. `tools/font.py` creates 24px and 32px LVGL UI fonts. Speaker's README reserves rights to its embedded/Dingos fonts; these are not copied. Lilita One supplies the heavy display type for the adapted menu hierarchy.
- Generated face features and palettes come directly from this repository's `src/web/src/lib/avatar/{face,theme}.ts` through `tools/assets.mts`; the logo comes from `assets/alook.svg`. The preview's example custom photo is this repository's `src/web/public/landing/people/lin.webp`, used only as sample content.

Dependency archives, versions and SHA-256 values are in dependencies.lock.json. Tooling downloads them into the ignored task-local .cache directory. Source licenses and required notices remain with copied or adapted code.

- `firmware/touch/speaker_renderer.cpp` reuses Speaker c9ed3ef's `irGenFrame` and `animIdleRainbow` arithmetic:11 RGB888112px frames,30-degree yaw,16-step inter-frame and bilinear weights, overscan, fixed vignette/highlights, two internal row caches and ordered RGB565 dither. `tests/reference/speaker_idle.h` contains the unchanged original renderer excerpts; test inputs use a466px display, identity color transform, deterministic noise and injected poses. `tests/reference/speaker_idle.binding.json` binds the original ranges. Data adapters: Alook's existing seed selects its original single face color and canonical indexed eye/mouth masks; each eye half and mouth anchor uses Speaker's sphere projection and blends the original mask into the completed canvas. A custom photo supplies an RGB888112px texture instead of Gaussian color points and gets the same yaw frames, lighting, interpolation, sampling and circular boundary. Social encounter scale/bounce modes are outside Touch scope.
- `firmware/touch/panel_dma.cpp` adapts Speaker's16380-pixel chunks, two internal ping-pong buffers, pairwise byte swap and ordered completion ownership to public queued CO5300 panel IO. The original TFT_DC window commands and GPIO ownership switch are not applicable to this board. All panel traffic uses the official QSPI driver; last-chunk DMA may continue while the next canvas is drawn. Panel parameter commands serialize through the same IO, as required by esp_lcd.
- Espressif `esp_lcd_co5300`2.2.0, Apache-2.0, pinned source2d289eb1f14431e345b345c3fd6fc299a555d770: https://github.com/espressif/esp-iot-solution/tree/2d289eb1f14431e345b345c3fd6fc299a555d770/components/display/lcd/esp_lcd_co5300. Unchanged common/SPI translation units, public/private headers and license are in `firmware/touch/src/vendor/esp_lcd_co5300`. MIPI translation unit is omitted for ESP32-S3. Arduino build_opt.h supplies the same2.2.0 version definitions normally generated by the component CMake cu_pkg_define_version helper. Archive and individual hashes are in dependencies.lock.json.
- Waveshare board BSP3.0.0, Apache-2.0, pinned23a6012d5e87d27399cf90fb851cab3689e29159: https://github.com/waveshareteam/Waveshare-ESP32-components. `panel_dma.cpp` uses this board's exact CO5300 initialization sequence, RGB16 order and(6,0)gap; QSPI starts at the official40MHz clock. The panel driver supplies brightness control. Source URL/hash are in dependencies.lock.json.

The r16 photo adapter samples the original photo once at the continuous inverse-projected coordinate, then applies precomputed reference rim/highlight coefficients before the unchanged half-resolution bilinear upscale/dither. It does not crossfade two displaced photo frames, which made sharp contours appear twice in r15. Generated-avatar default-palette reference fixtures remain byte-identical. This adapter follows inverse-mapping/resampling semantics (https://docs.opencv.org/4.5.1/da/d54/group__imgproc__transform.html), without importing OpenCV. Panel chunks now obey Waveshare's even-start/even-size requirement; the16380px maximum and ownership remain unchanged. Arduino build_opt.h enables-O2 and LVGL8 uses standard memory routines, following Espressif LCD performance guidance; precompiled IDF cache/PSRAM settings remain unchanged.

The row sampler evaluates the original integer bilinear numerator as vertical16-bit intermediates and a horizontal sum, with no intermediate rounding. One internal duplicated-pixel RGB565 row is copied to each of the two output rows using standard memcpy. The original texture/upscale reference remains byte-identical. For the actual UI, one explicit final circular row-span mask and the existing halo downsampled into the112px texture replace duplicate LVGL full-frame mask/alpha operations; the completed opaque466px image uses LVGL8's untransformed/unmasked path. Existing LVGL fading remains unchanged.
